paper.title: Contextual Bandits for Unbounded Context Distributions

settings.name_in_paper: Nonparametric contextual bandit with bounded context support (Assumptions 1 and 2)
unmapped: Nonparametric reward functions eta_a(x) Lipschitz in the context x (constant L)
Tsybakov margin condition P(0<eta*(X)-eta_a(X)<u) <= C_alpha u^alpha with alpha <= d
Context pdf f bounded below by c on its (bounded) support
Contexts in R^d drawn i.i.d. from density f
settings.definition_quote: At the $t$-th step, the context $\mathbf{X}_t$ is a random variable drawn from a distribution with probability density function (pdf) $f$. Then the agent takes action $A_t\in \mathcal{A}$ and receive reward $Y_t=\eta_{A_t}(\mathbf{X}_t)+W_t$ ... Assumption 2: $f(\mathbf{x})\geq c$ for all $\mathbf{x}\in \mathcal{X}$

settings.name_in_paper: Nonparametric contextual bandit with unbounded / heavy-tailed contexts (Assumptions 1 and 3)
unmapped: Nonparametric reward functions eta_a(x) Lipschitz in the context x (constant L)
Tsybakov margin condition with exponent alpha <= d
Context tail condition P(f(X) <= u) <= C_beta u^beta (tail parameter beta), unbounded support allowed
Bounded gap: sup_x (eta*(x) - min_a eta_a(x)) <= M
settings.definition_quote: Assumption 3: (a) For any $u>0$, $\text{P}(f(\mathbf{X})\leq u)\leq C_\beta u^\beta$ for some constants $C_\beta$ and $\beta$; (b) ... $\sup_{\mathbf{x}\in \mathcal{X}} (\eta^*(\mathbf{x})-\min_a \eta_a(\mathbf{x}))\leq M$

settings.name_in_paper: Nonparametric contextual bandit with unbounded contexts (lower bound)
unmapped: Nonparametric reward functions Lipschitz in the context
Tsybakov margin condition with exponent alpha <= d
Context tail condition P(f(X) <= u) <= C_beta u^beta; bounded gap M
settings.definition_quote: Denote $\mathcal{F}_B$ as the set of pairs $(f,\eta)$ that satisfy Assumption 1 and 3 (which means that the contexts have unbounded support).

source.label: thm:fixed
source.quote: Under Assumption 1 and 2, the regret of the simple nearest neighbor method with UCB exploration is bounded as follows: (1) If $d>\alpha+1$, then with $k\sim T^\frac{2}{d+2}$, $R\lesssim T^{1-\frac{\alpha+1}{d+2}}|\mathcal{A}| \ln^{\frac{\alpha+1}{2}}(dT^{2d+2}|\mathcal{A}|)$

results.notes: |A| mapped to K. Regret defined via means of eta, so pseudo-regret against per-context best action. Constants hidden by \lesssim.

bound.expression: T**(1 - beta_tail*Min(d, alpha_margin + 1)/(Min(d - 1, alpha_margin) + Max(1, d*beta_tail) + 2*beta_tail))*K*log(d*T**(2*d + 2)*K)**(Max(d, alpha_margin + 1)/2)

source.label: thm:fixedtail
source.quote: Under Assumption 1 and 3, the regret of the simple nearest neighbor method with UCB exploration is bounded as follows: $R\lesssim T^{1-\frac{\beta \min(d,\alpha+1)}{\min(d-1,\alpha)+\max(1,d\beta)+2\beta}}|\mathcal{A}|\ln^{\frac{1}{2}\max(d,\alpha+1)} (dT^{2d+2}|\mathcal{A}|)$.

results.notes: Theorem does not state k; the proof chooses k depending on alpha and beta (the text claims beta need not be known, but the proof's k choices depend on beta). Recorded as stated.

source.label: thm:adaptive
source.quote: Under Assumption 1 and 2, the regret of the adaptive nearest neighbor method with UCB exploration is bounded by $R\lesssim T|\mathcal{A}|\left(\frac{T}{\ln T}\right)^{-\frac{1+\alpha}{d+2}}$.

results.notes: Matches minimax lower bound of Rigollet & Zeevi up to log factors.

source.label: thm:mmxunbound
source.quote: Denote $\mathcal{F}_B$ as the set of pairs $(f,\eta)$ that satisfy Assumption 1 and 3 (which means that the contexts have unbounded support). Then $\inf_\pi \underset{(f,\eta)\in \mathcal{F}_B}{\sup} R\gtrsim T^{1-\frac{(\alpha+1)\beta}{\alpha+(d+2)\beta}}+T^{1-\beta}$.

results.notes: Construction uses two actions (paper notes minimax lower bounds are for two actions).
